title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: carpentry fit-out
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Wall and bulkhead framing
swms.task: Frame steel stud walls and bulkheads in the apartments and corridors, working from platform ladders and mobile scaffolds, and moving materials up by hoist.

steps: Move materials and joinery to the floors
Cut and fix steel studs and track

swms.title: Doors, joinery and cabinets
swms.task: Install door frames, doors, kitchen cabinets, vanities and wardrobes in the apartments, moving joinery to the floors by hoist.

steps: Move materials and joinery to the floors

swms.title: Carpentry near balcony edges and voids
swms.task: Install timber handrails and balcony screens near the balcony edges and stair voids, using drop saws and nail guns.

facts.fallControl: Balcony balustrades and void edge protection stay in place, except where opened one section at a time under the permit procedure in this SWMS.

steps: Work near balcony edges, voids and penetrations
